requirements_summary: Mid-market SaaS (product analytics) wants embeddings+semantic search across multi-tenant customers. Primary workload: nightly batch vectorization of ~5M documents (ETL windows) + low-latency semantic search for product UI (p95 < 120ms). Throughput targets: 1k qps peak read, batch upserts ~200k vectors/hour. Need integration with Pinecone (bulk upsert) and S3-based batch pipelines. Cost sensitive to tokenized preprocessing and nightly job egress. Prefer hosted API to iterate quickly, roadmap to Dedicated for reserved GPU pools once throughput and SLA validated. Must satisfy SSO/SAML, SOC2, audit logs and EU data residency for select customers.
